events_provenance.note: The source is a rolling 90-day file regenerated every ~4h; reproduce analyses from THIS archived snapshot, not the live file.

events_reproduction_recipe: events_score7plus.csv is the PRE-exclusion, PRE-dedup universe (score>=7 only; scores 1-6 appear solely in aggregate tables). To reproduce n_measured cells: keep rows where BOTH exclusion_reason AND dataset_excluded are empty, then one observation per (ticker, NY date of accepted_at_utc) keeping the highest score (earliest accepted_at on ties). t1_pct is RAW; subtract tape_series[t1_date] from meta.json for excess. Verified to reproduce all score-level cells exactly at publication.
panel_note: Filer panel and tape are fixed to THIS window (90 days ending at the window end). The overlapping monthly release uses its own month-end panel, so shared events can show slightly different excess values there; monthly figures are canonical.
scoring_model_note: Scores and sentiment are point-in-time as stored at enrichment; never re-scored after the fact.

definitions.event_leg: publication price -> exact next-session close (T+1); this release is T+1-only (T+5 arrives with the monthly series)
definitions.tape_leg: filer-panel close-to-close median for the same t1_date session; panel = tickers with >=1 SEC filing in the 90 days ending at THIS WINDOW's (exclusive) end date (one fixed panel for the window, NY dates) and a real close pair
definitions.excess: event T+1 move minus same-session tape median; legs intentionally differ and are disclosed
